entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted open-source project, a managed cloud service, or an SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction. This official provider archives sessions as editable Markdown files and demonstrated a 43-49% task-completion gain over baselines in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It distills session lessons into searchable permanent memory and supports local extraction models that do not require LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports multi-modal extraction from sources like PDFs and video. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and provides sub-300ms recall with byte-level deduplication for efficient prompt-caching.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores explicit facts with provenance across multiple connected agents to provide cited answers and gap analysis. It supports both local and remote deployment via MCP and Bun for flexible integration.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark and supports over 25 LLM providers across Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library implemented as a FastAPI server that serves as the upstream foundation for self-hosted Hermes wrappers. It supports managed or Docker-based deployments and integrates with various clients including Claude Code and Cursor-compatible tools.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP or a Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to provide structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to help agents with complex tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents by using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from the persistence layer.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It automatically strips keys and tokens during the indexing process, allowing users to search months of past sessions.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent state management.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent tool portability. It utilizes an MCP server integration to provide hybrid retrieval through BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy in benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 with vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search. The architecture is unique for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models while supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result. It includes primitives for contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop designed to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, links, and provenance across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent per query. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary context, reportedly reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It features local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to navigate stored notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to establish bidirectional relationships between entries.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It provides a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents between different agent environments.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services directly using stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to provide agents with searchable capability routing. It supports neighbor traversal for knowledge retrieval and can automatically generate tool-OKF via detached model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer to ensure write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through a required local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It combines HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval with MinHash deduplication for precise context recall.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information during agent operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit implements a file-based memory loop using a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database. It features five slash commands for capture and recall, alongside 'rot' and 'lint' curators that identify stale data or contradictions to propose evidence-cited updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It enables agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is designed for compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms to bolster cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It features an incremental sync capability that preserves manual layouts and offers both a CLI and MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill manages natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It incorporates a master router with verification and dispute resolution layers to facilitate secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process. It offers five voice profiles and three distinct modes: rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos. It integrates with Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring accounts or telemetry. The skills are designed for immediate use across major assistants including Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to self-generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI with remote registry access via Git and S3. It provides sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to support long-running agent operations.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production, backups, and cron automation in Portuguese. It supports broad communication integrations including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, and is deployable via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills specifically designed for the FLUX 3 video ecosystem.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing and testing while linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates through a single Rust binary and four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It maintains local traces and verification journals for every execution run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It handles recursive dependency resolution during installation and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill enables autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project provides agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple interfaces such as Discord, Telegram, and CLI, supporting 97 different languages. It aims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five programming languages and incorporates a tiered application process that requires an approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates at multiple stages. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and facilitates the automatic registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address CVE-driven scenarios spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides session management and worktree recovery tools to maintain memory and state between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new agent skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, error tracking, and session history. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and offers an optional script for incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire workflow from rendering and compression to embedding the final markdown, ensuring files remain under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands and integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical drift through weekly spec monitoring. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluation frameworks.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on documents, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It utilizes macOS Vision for data extraction and includes a rule-based engine for refining AI-generated text.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures compatibility by verifying existing project runtimes and routing file operations using environment-specific syntax.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite offers skills for social data enrichment, web scraping, and lead prospecting alongside a workspace Postgres integration. It supports MCP server standards and is compatible with agentskills.io clients for SEO and content automation workflows.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This service certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or hosting their own bounty boards. It facilitates decentralized payments via x402 without requiring accounts or API keys, using a dedicated wallet for automated payouts.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data across 31 platforms. It operates via a hosted MCP server and supports multiple AI clients including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool utilizes a Rust-powered kernel to maintain a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that auto-syncs on every file change. It integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to minimize token usage and tool calls by providing immediate access to codebase context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that monitors token consumption and costs for multiple AI agents, including Hermes, through local session files and transcripts. It offers developers both a command-line interface and a 3D visualization dashboard to track usage across various platforms.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget tracks live token usage, costs, and rate limits across more than 38 tools, reading state directly from the Hermes Agent CLI. It features real-time synchronization across multiple machines and provides historical breakdowns by model and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting for UI development.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as a CTO and Builder, to manage the full application lifecycle under Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring human approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based configuration files. Developers can apply diverse themes, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk aesthetics, to modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce through Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It specifically includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends these memory capabilities to chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, supported by an automated cross-platform installation script.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts against HERM v1.1 scoring standards. It operates locally without LLM calls to detect ambiguous tools, missing bounds, and contract mismatches across Markdown, JSON, YAML, and Python patterns.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on local configurations and skills.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installer deploys a complete hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes at zero cost. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It uses zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating online revenue, this tool functions as a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default. It ensures safety by requiring explicit approval for all consequential actions and external writes through specific contracts for opportunities and offers.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes integrates with MemOS to provide multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access. It supports both built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent and provides remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This interface runs the Hermes agent in-process to maintain 1:1 feature parity with the CLI without requiring an external API server. It utilizes a three-panel layout to organize sessions, chat, and file browsing for web and mobile users.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a graphical interface for managing sessions, tools, and chat across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers unified configuration for ten communication platforms and supports runtimes including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal alongside specialized tools for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration. It can be deployed as a desktop app, Docker container, or standalone server with native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing dedicated management for chat and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows users to switch between multi-agent profiles and use AI-assisted tab scoping to control prompt context.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted agent from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for skills and scheduled tasks.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It tracks per-session token burn and estimated costs using a locally built search index that avoids uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports the management of profiles, skills, and toolsets, and includes a kanban board for agentic task management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA for Telegram that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supported by a built-in workflow engine for multi-step pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, MCP servers, and an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard that provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
